issues.title: Missing Join Condition
issues.problem: The query pairs every customer with every order due to the absence of a join condition.

issues.title: Implicit Join Syntax
issues.problem: Using the comma-separated table list in the FROM clause is less readable and more prone to errors.
issues.fix: SELECT customers.name, orders.order_date FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id;

review.corrected_sql: SELECT customers.customer_name AS name, orders.transaction_date AS order_date FROM sigma_analytics.dim_customer AS customers JOIN sigma_analytics.fact_transactions AS orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id;
review.summary: The query had a critical correctness issue due to missing join condition and a readability issue with the implicit join syntax.
